scope: Plain-language descriptions of existing diagram responsibilities; not new services or new runtime evidence

nodes.english: Provides a due check or an HTTP wake request.
nodes.zh_Hant: 時間到了，或外部送來喚醒要求；這是工作開始的原因。

nodes.english: Accepts the wake request, queues its context and requests an immediate heartbeat only when asked.
nodes.zh_Hant: 收下喚醒要求，把內容排進對話；要求立即處理時，才請 heartbeat 現在執行。

nodes.english: Keeps event context for the target session to consume on a turn.
nodes.zh_Hant: 替指定對話保存事件內容，讓同事開始工作時有資料可讀。

nodes.english: Checks whether the heartbeat may run, then starts the agent check.
nodes.zh_Hant: 先確認現在可不可以執行，再叫同事開始這次檢查。

nodes.english: Finds a saved job whose scheduled time has arrived.
nodes.zh_Hant: 查看已存的排程，找出現在該開始的工作。

nodes.english: Reads the job configuration and selects the requested execution path.
nodes.zh_Hant: 讀工作設定，判斷要叫 agent、跑腳本，還是走 heartbeat 等入口。

nodes.english: Executes the configured program; this branch need not call a model.
nodes.zh_Hant: 執行設定好的小程式；這條路徑不一定要叫模型。

nodes.english: Checks whether the heartbeat may run, then starts the agent check.
nodes.zh_Hant: 先確認現在可不可以執行，再叫同事開始這次檢查。

nodes.english: Sends a work event from a connected business system.
nodes.zh_Hant: 外部業務系統送來消息，例如新客服單或待審文件。

nodes.english: Checks the inbound HTTP request and resolves its requested agent/session target.
nodes.zh_Hant: 檢查外部 HTTP 通知，確認這份工作要交給哪個 agent／對話。

nodes.english: Checks whether the requested work can enter the target session.
nodes.zh_Hant: 檢查這份工作能不能進入指定對話執行。

nodes.english: Starts the agent work with the accepted event as context.
nodes.zh_Hant: 把通過檢查的事件交給 agent，開始讀資料與處理工作。

nodes.english: Runs the long command whose completion the automation is waiting for.
nodes.zh_Hant: 正在執行的長時間命令，例如那批資料檢查。

nodes.english: Detects that the watched command has exited and emits the completion trigger.
nodes.zh_Hant: 發現命令已結束，就發出完成訊號，不必靠猜時間。

nodes.english: Routes an accepted watcher trigger through the shared execution admission path.
nodes.zh_Hant: 把監看器發出的觸發交到共用入口，確認可執行後再派送。

nodes.english: Executes the selected automation through the common job service, including event-triggered jobs.
nodes.zh_Hant: 共用的工作執行服務；不只處理定時工作，也接事件觸發的自動化。

nodes.english: Produces live output lines that the configured watcher can inspect.
nodes.zh_Hant: 持續輸出新紀錄的程式，例如系統錯誤監看命令。

nodes.english: Matches output lines and collects a bounded batch before triggering work.
nodes.zh_Hant: 挑出符合設定的紀錄，短暫收成一批，再交給同事一起看。

nodes.english: Routes an accepted watcher trigger through the shared execution admission path.
nodes.zh_Hant: 把監看器發出的觸發交到共用入口，確認可執行後再派送。

nodes.english: Executes the selected automation through the common job service, including event-triggered jobs.
nodes.zh_Hant: 共用的工作執行服務；不只處理定時工作，也接事件觸發的自動化。

nodes.english: Supplies a scheduled check or new process output to the condition watcher.
nodes.zh_Hant: 定時到點，或程式有新輸出，讓條件檢查開始。

nodes.english: Reads the job configuration and selects the requested execution path.
nodes.zh_Hant: 讀工作設定，判斷要叫 agent、跑腳本，還是走 heartbeat 等入口。

nodes.english: Runs the configured condition script; false skips work and true allows dispatch.
nodes.zh_Hant: 先跑條件腳本；不符合就略過，符合才放行後續工作。

nodes.english: Runs the job action selected after the condition passes.
nodes.zh_Hant: 條件通過後，才真正執行設定的工作內容。

nodes.english: The current job may request a delay for its next check.
nodes.zh_Hant: 這次正在工作的 agent，可提出下次隔多久再查。

nodes.english: Checks the completed run and processes its next-check request.
nodes.zh_Hant: 收下本次結果，確認成功等條件後，處理下次檢查要求。

nodes.english: Applies the allowed timing bounds to the requested next check.
nodes.zh_Hant: 把建議的檢查間隔限制在設定範圍內，避免太密或太晚。

nodes.english: Stores the accepted next due time for the scheduler.
nodes.zh_Hant: 保存核准後的下次時間，讓排程器之後照時間啟動。

nodes.english: Provides the completed work that may qualify for review.
nodes.zh_Hant: 剛結束的工作回合，提供可供回顧的經過與成果。

nodes.english: Arranges delayed review instead of interrupting the just-finished work.
nodes.zh_Hant: 安排稍後回顧，不把改善指引的工作擠進剛完成的回合。

nodes.english: Determines whether this completed work meets the review conditions.
nodes.zh_Hant: 判斷這次工作是否符合回顧條件，不是每件事都重看。

nodes.english: Performs the review and applies only permitted Workshop changes.
nodes.zh_Hant: 執行回顧，把有用經驗改進到允許修改的 Workshop 內容。

nodes.english: Supplies the configured memory-maintenance behavior and jobs.
nodes.zh_Hant: 提供記憶整理功能及其排程設定。

nodes.english: Aligns managed maintenance jobs with the current configuration.
nodes.zh_Hant: 對照目前設定，補齊或調整應存在的記憶整理工作。

nodes.english: Executes the selected automation through the common job service, including event-triggered jobs.
nodes.zh_Hant: 共用的工作執行服務；不只處理定時工作，也接事件觸發的自動化。

nodes.english: Organizes stored experience and promotes useful memory.
nodes.zh_Hant: 整理已保存的經驗，把有用資訊留下供以後工作使用。

nodes.english: Requests that a goal be created or updated.
nodes.zh_Hant: 要求建立或更新一個交辦目標的呼叫者。

nodes.english: Validates and applies the requested goal-state operation.
nodes.zh_Hant: 檢查要求，執行目標新增或狀態修改；本身不證明會自動續跑。

nodes.english: Persists the goal and session data for later reads.
nodes.zh_Hant: 保存目標與對話資料，讓之後能讀回交辦事項。

nodes.english: Periodically checks whether saved jobs are due.
nodes.zh_Hant: 定期看已存工作是否到時間；到期才交下去。

nodes.english: Claims and runs the due job using the configured script or agent path.
nodes.zh_Hant: 取得這次工作的執行權，再依設定跑腳本或叫 agent。

nodes.english: Executes the configured program; this branch need not call a model.
nodes.zh_Hant: 執行設定好的小程式；這條路徑不一定要叫模型。

nodes.english: Reads the assigned prompt and performs the work with available tools.
nodes.zh_Hant: 讀交辦內容，用可用工具完成這次工作並產生結果。

nodes.english: Sends a work event from a connected business system.
nodes.zh_Hant: 外部業務系統送來消息，例如新客服單或待審文件。

nodes.english: Checks the external notice and turns accepted content into a message or direct delivery.
nodes.zh_Hant: 檢查外部通知，將可接受內容轉成工作訊息，或按設定直接送達。

nodes.english: Receives the normalized event and dispatches the conversation work.
nodes.zh_Hant: 接到整理好的事件訊息，把它送入對話工作流程。

nodes.english: Sends the configured output through the chosen destination.
nodes.zh_Hant: 把結果送到設定好的目的地，例如私人聊天室。

nodes.english: Checks when a session should be revisited and whether user work is waiting.
nodes.zh_Hant: 看看對話是否該回訪、使用者是否正有工作等著處理。

nodes.english: Holds session status and queued work that affect whether a check can start.
nodes.zh_Hant: 保存對話狀態與待處理工作，決定現在是否方便做定期檢查。

nodes.english: Manages the configured session heartbeat and its pending checks.
nodes.zh_Hant: 管理這段對話的 heartbeat 設定與待執行檢查。

nodes.english: Submits the heartbeat work through the normal conversation interface.
nodes.zh_Hant: 把 heartbeat 的檢查要求轉成一般對話能處理的工作。

nodes.english: Initiates a loop tick when the next repetition is due.
nodes.zh_Hant: 到了再做一次的時間，就發出本輪執行要求。

nodes.english: Manages loop settings, stop checks and the next repetition.
nodes.zh_Hant: 管理重複工作的設定，檢查該停了沒，以及是否還有下一輪。

nodes.english: Stores loop state so the configured repetition can be tracked.
nodes.zh_Hant: 保存 loop 的設定與狀態，讓系統知道這項重複工作進行到哪。

nodes.english: Executes one iteration of the assigned loop work.
nodes.zh_Hant: 叫 agent 執行這一次檢查或工作；是否還要再做由 loop 控制決定。

nodes.english: Provides the latest result of work on an assigned goal.
nodes.zh_Hant: 剛結束的一輪工作，提供本次交辦目標的處理結果。

nodes.english: Runs goal-continuation checks after the turn ends.
nodes.zh_Hant: 回合結束時接手，開始檢查目標是否還要繼續。

nodes.english: Evaluates goal progress and limits, then chooses continue, wait, pause or done.
nodes.zh_Hant: 看目標進度與限制，決定繼續、等待、暫停或完成。

nodes.english: Queues an eligible continuation in order for the same session.
nodes.zh_Hant: 把允許的續跑要求放進同一對話的順序佇列，等候執行。

nodes.english: Scans the task board for work whose dependencies allow it to start.
nodes.zh_Hant: 掃描工作板，看看哪些任務的前置工作已經備妥。

nodes.english: Stores tasks that are eligible for dispatch after dependency checks.
nodes.zh_Hant: 保存前置條件已滿足、可以派工的任務資料。

nodes.english: Claims ready work for an available execution lane.
nodes.zh_Hant: 有執行空間時取得任務，安排到可用的執行路徑。

nodes.english: Runs the assigned task using the worker agent and its tools.
nodes.zh_Hant: 真正執行被派來的工作，用工具讀資料並產生成果。

nodes.english: Finishes the current turn and invokes eligible follow-up maintenance.
nodes.zh_Hant: 收尾目前回合，再啟動符合條件的後續維護。

nodes.english: The agent object supplies the completed work and review context.
nodes.zh_Hant: 提供這次 agent 工作的內容，供背景回顧使用。

nodes.english: Reviews completed work and records improvements within restricted write rules.
nodes.zh_Hant: 重看已完成工作，在限制範圍內保存改善方式。

nodes.english: Sends a due-job request from the external scheduling service.
nodes.zh_Hant: 外部排程服務到了時間，送出這次工作的啟動要求。

nodes.english: Accepts and authenticates the remote scheduled-run request.
nodes.zh_Hant: 收下外部排程通知，檢查是否來自允許的來源。

nodes.english: Claims the scheduled occurrence before passing it to execution.
nodes.zh_Hant: 先取得這次排程的執行權，再交給工作執行器。

nodes.english: Claims and runs the due job using the configured script or agent path.
nodes.zh_Hant: 取得這次工作的執行權，再依設定跑腳本或叫 agent。

nodes.english: Checks which saved routines have reached their next scheduled time.
nodes.zh_Hant: 掃描已存的例行工作，找出到時間該執行的項目。

nodes.english: Keeps routine definitions and their scheduling state.
nodes.zh_Hant: 保存例行工作的交辦內容與排程狀態。

nodes.english: Keeps assigned work pending until a worker claims it.
nodes.zh_Hant: 把工作持久保存進佇列，等執行者來接，不只留在記憶體。

nodes.english: Checks current ownership and access, then runs the routine in its channel.
nodes.zh_Hant: 確認目前負責人與權限，再在設定的頻道執行例行工作。

nodes.english: The colleague that needs another specialist to perform a task.
nodes.zh_Hant: 原本工作的同事；他需要專家幫忙，所以發起派工。

nodes.english: Packages the specialist request with its task and identity information.
nodes.zh_Hant: 把要專家做的事、期待成果與身分資訊包成派工要求。

nodes.english: Checks handoff authority and records the durable delivery to the recipient.
nodes.zh_Hant: 檢查能否派給對方，再保存這份要送出的任務。

nodes.english: Starts the specialist task under the recipient’s own tools and permissions.
nodes.zh_Hant: 叫接任務的專家開工，沿用專家自己的工具與權限。

nodes.english: The specialist completes the assigned work and produces an answer.
nodes.zh_Hant: 接任務的專家完成工作，交出答案。

nodes.english: Processes the completed handoff and prepares an answer relay.
nodes.zh_Hant: 處理已完成的派工，準備把答案送回原本求助方。

nodes.english: Stores the result delivery waiting to reach the original requester.
nodes.zh_Hant: 保存待回傳的成果，等候送回原本提問的同事。

nodes.english: Receives the answer to its earlier specialist request.
nodes.zh_Hant: 原本求助的同事，現在收到專家的回答。

nodes.english: Periodically initiates ownership renewal while a task is still running.
nodes.zh_Hant: 工作還在跑時，定期發起執行權續租。

nodes.english: Lists the task and thread ownership keys held by this worker.
nodes.zh_Hant: 記住這個執行者目前持有哪些工作與對話的執行權。

nodes.english: Refreshes the lease for work that the worker still owns.
nodes.zh_Hant: 替仍由這位執行者負責的工作更新租期。

nodes.english: Continues the existing work while ownership is maintained.
nodes.zh_Hant: 在執行權維持有效時繼續原本工作；續租本身不會多開思考回合。

nodes.english: Polls for cloud automation records to handle locally.
nodes.zh_Hant: 本機接收程式定期查看雲端，有沒有尚未處理的自動化通知。

nodes.english: Provides cloud-side automation records; its scheduling decision is outside this evidence.
nodes.zh_Hant: 提供雲端自動化紀錄；這裡的證據沒有涵蓋雲端如何決定排程。

nodes.english: Tracks which automation events have been observed or handled locally.
nodes.zh_Hant: 記下本機看過或處理過哪些事件，供重複與執行檢查使用。

nodes.english: Validates and handles an accepted automation-run request.
nodes.zh_Hant: 檢查並處理已接收的自動化執行要求。

nodes.english: Supplies new background information for an existing conversation.
nodes.zh_Hant: 帶來要交進既有對話的新背景消息。

nodes.english: Collects background events and determines the wake-up path.
nodes.zh_Hant: 收集背景事件，安排如何喚醒對話繼續處理。

nodes.english: Keeps the existing conversation and its running or idle state.
nodes.zh_Hant: 保存原本對話內容，以及目前忙碌或閒置的狀態。

nodes.english: Queues the accepted follow-up until the conversation can handle it.
nodes.zh_Hant: 把可處理的後續要求排隊，等對話能執行時接手。

nodes.english: Provides completion output from a delegated agent.
nodes.zh_Hant: 被委派出去的 agent 做完了，交回成果。

nodes.english: Checks completion ownership and duplicates before accepting the result.
nodes.zh_Hant: 先確認成果屬於誰、是否重複，再接受完成通知。

nodes.english: Holds returned results until the waiting conversation can consume them.
nodes.zh_Hant: 先保存返回的成果，等原本等待中的對話讀取。

nodes.english: Requests a follow-up in the waiting conversation using accepted results.
nodes.zh_Hant: 用已接受的成果，要求原本等待的對話接著處理。

nodes.english: Submits a goal-continuation action; its automatic producer is unverified.
nodes.zh_Hant: 送出目標續跑要求；目前未證實誰會自動發起它。

nodes.english: Checks the requested continuation and stops repeated no-progress turns.
nodes.zh_Hant: 檢查續跑要求，遇到連續沒有進展的回合可暫停。

nodes.english: Stores the goal identity and progress used to validate continuation.
nodes.zh_Hant: 保存目標身分與進度，供續跑要求檢查使用。

nodes.english: Receives an accepted continuation as new conversation input.
nodes.zh_Hant: 把通過檢查的續跑要求，接成對話裡的新輸入。

nodes.english: Repeats task selection and execution within the exploration budget.
nodes.zh_Hant: 在探索限制內，反覆選任務、執行任務、更新進度。

nodes.english: Chooses the next Minecraft task using world state and task history.
nodes.zh_Hant: 看 Minecraft 環境與做過的事，選出下一個值得做的任務。

nodes.english: Attempts the selected task by generating and executing game actions.
nodes.zh_Hant: 為選定任務產生並執行遊戲操作，嘗試把任務完成。

nodes.english: Records task outcomes for the next curriculum decision.
nodes.zh_Hant: 記下任務成果，讓下次選任務時知道已經會什麼。

nodes.english: Generates and executes the next code attempt for the current task.
nodes.zh_Hant: 為目前任務產生並執行下一次操作程式。

nodes.english: Returns observed state or errors from the game or watched system.
nodes.zh_Hant: 回傳外界實際狀態或錯誤；遊戲圖是 Minecraft，Monitor 圖是被監看的系統。

nodes.english: Checks whether the task succeeded and supplies feedback if it did not.
nodes.zh_Hant: 判斷任務到底完成沒，沒完成就提供回饋。

nodes.english: Carries observed errors and feedback into the next code attempt.
nodes.zh_Hant: 把錯誤與回饋放進下一次輸入，讓 agent 修正操作程式。

nodes.english: Starts or revisits the scheduled app chat when its saved time arrives.
nodes.zh_Hant: 到了已存時間，啟動或回訪 App 裡的排程對話。

nodes.english: Runs the saved assignment and reads available sources.
nodes.zh_Hant: 執行原本交辦的工作，讀取可用資料來源。

nodes.english: Shows the findings in the app’s scheduled-task result surface.
nodes.zh_Hant: 在 App 的排程結果介面呈現這次發現。

nodes.english: Signals that the thread has become idle after a turn.
nodes.zh_Hant: 告知回合已結束，這段 thread 目前閒置。

nodes.english: Checks active-goal eligibility and prepares continuation input.
nodes.zh_Hant: 檢查目標是否仍可續跑，準備下一輪工作輸入。

nodes.english: Starts the eligible continuation only if the thread remains idle.
nodes.zh_Hant: thread 仍閒置且符合條件，才真正開始下一輪。

nodes.english: Your integration listens to the external system and receives its event.
nodes.zh_Hant: 你接的整合程式，負責監聽外部系統與接收事件。

nodes.english: Your code converts the event into a prompt or engine turn request.
nodes.zh_Hant: 你的程式把事件轉成 prompt 或啟動回合的要求。

nodes.english: Runs the requested reasoning and tool work and returns its outcome.
nodes.zh_Hant: Codex 執行被要求的推理與工具工作，回傳成果。

nodes.english: Emits the completion event when agent work finishes.
nodes.zh_Hant: agent 工作完成時，發出回合結束事件。

nodes.english: Builds the completion payload and invokes the configured notification path.
nodes.zh_Hant: 整理回合完成資料，再啟動設定的通知路徑。

nodes.english: Your script sends the actual notification or downstream event.
nodes.zh_Hant: 你設定的腳本，才是真正送通知或往下發事件的地方。

nodes.english: Keeps the in-session schedule and queues work when it is due.
nodes.zh_Hant: 保存對話內排程，時間到了就把工作排進對話。

nodes.english: Receives the work or new information and uses available tools to handle it.
nodes.zh_Hant: 收到工作或新消息，再使用可用工具處理。

nodes.english: Supplies the current status or data the scheduled task needs to inspect.
nodes.zh_Hant: 提供這次定期檢查要看的最新資料或工作狀態。

nodes.english: Receives the work or new information and uses available tools to handle it.
nodes.zh_Hant: 收到工作或新消息，再使用可用工具處理。

nodes.english: Keeps observing the configured source and reports output to the session.
nodes.zh_Hant: 持續看設定的資料來源，有輸出就把消息帶回對話。

nodes.english: Returns observed state or errors from the game or watched system.
nodes.zh_Hant: 回傳外界實際狀態或錯誤；遊戲圖是 Minecraft，Monitor 圖是被監看的系統。

nodes.english: Accepts allowed platform messages and forwards them into the running session.
nodes.zh_Hant: 接收平台上允許的訊息，再轉進正在執行的對話。

nodes.english: Receives the work or new information and uses available tools to handle it.
nodes.zh_Hant: 收到工作或新消息，再使用可用工具處理。

nodes.english: Sends an agent-selected reply back through the connected platform.
nodes.zh_Hant: agent 決定回覆時，用這個工具送回已連接的平台。

nodes.english: Finds a due desktop task and starts its local session.
nodes.zh_Hant: 找出到期的 Desktop 工作，啟動本機對話。

nodes.english: Receives the work or new information and uses available tools to handle it.
nodes.zh_Hant: 收到工作或新消息，再使用可用工具處理。

nodes.english: Displays the desktop task’s notification and result.
nodes.zh_Hant: 在桌面介面顯示這次工作的通知與成果。

nodes.english: Accepts the configured cloud routine’s matching time or event trigger.
nodes.zh_Hant: 接收符合設定的時間或事件，作為雲端 routine 的啟動原因。

nodes.english: Runs the routine assignment in its configured cloud environment.
nodes.zh_Hant: 在設定好的雲端環境執行這份 routine 工作。

nodes.english: Reads configured sources or performs permitted connector actions.
nodes.zh_Hant: 讀已接好的資料來源，或執行允許的 connector 操作。

nodes.english: Detects the lifecycle event and invokes the configured hook.
nodes.zh_Hant: 工作到達指定時點，例如改檔後或準備結束，就呼叫 hook。

nodes.english: Runs your check and returns the applicable control decision.
nodes.zh_Hant: 執行你設定的檢查，回傳應採取的控制結果。

nodes.english: Continues work when required or allows the current task to stop.
nodes.zh_Hant: 需要補做就繼續處理，否則允許本次工作結束。
